locale.description: Locale used for SDD templates and skills.

extra_skills.description: Additional optional SDD skills to enable (extend candidates). On init --update, candidates = default workflow skills + this list; then `.agents/skills/llman-sdd-*` not in candidates are removed before rewrite. Valid values: llman-sdd-continue, llman-sdd-ff, llman-sdd-validate, llman-sdd-arch-review, llman-sdd-wayfinder, llman-sdd-research.

archive.description: Archive behaviour settings (defer tracking, completion gates).

strict_defer.description: When true, unchecked tasks without a defer link are errors (not just warnings). Default: false (transition period).

min_completion_ratio.description: Minimum task completion ratio (0.0–1.0) required for archiving. Default: none (disabled).

bdd.description: BDD integration settings. When defined, enables feature-as-spec mode (directory-based .feature validation) and BDD-aware verify prompts.

framework.description: BDD framework identifier (optional). Only used to derive a default run_command when run_command is unset.

feature_dir.description: Root directory for .feature files, relative to project root.

run_command.description: Custom test run command. Placeholders: {feature_dir}, {feature_name}, {feature_path}. Without placeholders, validate --all/--specs runs the command at most once per batch (batch-once).

verify_prompt.description: Extra prompt text injected during verify phase.

bindings.description: Declared harness-binding sources (r2). kind=tags: a scenario is bound when its tags contain all listed tags; kind=scenario-attrs: extract path/name literal pairs from #[scenario(...)] attribute blocks in glob-matched Rust files. Multiple sources union with dedup.

oneOf.description:
Tag predicate source: a `.feature` scenario is bound when its tags
contain ALL listed tags (`@` prefix optional).

tags.description: Required tag names (leading '@' optional). MUST NOT be empty.

oneOf.description:
Per-scenario attribute source: extract `path = "..."` / `name = "..."`
literal pairs from `#[scenario( ... )]` attribute blocks inside files
matching the given globs (repo-root relative). Feature paths outside
`llmanspec/specs/**` are ignored.

files.description: Glob patterns (repo-root relative) of Rust source files to scan for #[scenario(path=..., name=...)] attributes. MUST NOT be empty.

sdd.description: Unified Git-native flow tuning (branch prefix, worktree).

branch_prefix.description: Prefix for feature branches created by `change start`. Default: "sdd/".

worktree_root.description: Root directory for worktrees created by `change start --worktree`. Default: <repo>/.git/sdd/worktrees/.

worktree_naming.description: Worktree directory naming: "id" (default, = change-id) or "hash" (deterministic base32(sha256(change_id))[:8], letters only).
